candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: Text and all seven furigana readings are correct. Circled numbers ①–⑤ were converted to a plain '1.–5.' list, losing the original markers. The two-line blanks are collapsed into a single short blank.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: All text and furigana are correct, with circled numbers preserved. Blanks in ①–③ are split into two segments, reflecting the line-wrapped blanks in the image. Blank lengths are somewhat inconsistent, but this is the most faithful layout.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: All text and furigana are correct, with circled numbers preserved. Blanks are uniform short single segments, so the two-part blanks in ①–③ are not distinguished.

candidates.label: D
candidates.notes: Identical to C: accurate text and furigana, circled numbers kept. Blanks are simplified to one short segment each.

candidates.label: E
candidates.notes: Adds furigana (けんきゅうしゃ) to 研究者 in ①, which is not in the image. Uses 〜 instead of ～ in the heading, a trivial difference. Otherwise accurate, and the longer blanks in ①–③ loosely reflect the longer blanks in the image.

rationale: All candidates transcribe the main text correctly. B ranks first because it alone represents the split, two-line blanks in ①–③ while keeping the circled numbers. C and D are identical and accurate with simplified blanks; their relative order is arbitrary. A is accurate but replaces the circled numerals with a plain numbered list. E ranks last because it invents a furigana reading for 研究者 that is not in the image.
